cad-weighted-parameters.title: CAD weighted patch · typed parameters
cad-weighted-parameters.label: CAD weighted parameters
cad-weighted-parameters.description: Length parameters set the patch size and lifted corner. A scalar corner weight changes the rational shape. Change cornerWeight from 3 to 1; setting it to 0 refuses the candidate.

cad-curved-extrude.title: CAD curved extrusion · driven bow
cad-curved-extrude.label: CAD curved extrude
cad-curved-extrude.description: A quadratic profile uses length parameters for its span and bow. Extrude it along a native millimetre height. Change bow from 2 cm to 4 cm; height 0 mm refuses a zero vector.

cad-nonunit-curve.title: CAD rational arc · original parameter domain
cad-nonunit-curve.label: CAD nonunit curve
cad-nonunit-curve.description: The rational quarter-circle keeps its authored parameter domain 2 to 7. Change its middle weight to 1 to obtain a polynomial quadratic; descending knots refuse the candidate.

cad-rational-dome.title: CAD rational dome
cad-rational-dome.label: CAD rational dome
cad-rational-dome.description: A quadratic 3×3 rational Surface keeps its boundary flat while a typed rise and dimensionless center weight shape the interior. Edit centerWeight from 4 to 1 or rise from 2.4 cm to 3.6 cm, then compare native points and the sampled U/V grid.

expected.basis: Analytic tensor-product quadratic basis verified by selected public CPU evaluation; browser display is separate.
